original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚联邦首都区农牧民冲突致3人死亡，警方与军方部署
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚联邦首都区瓜瓜拉达地区委员会的Paikon-Kore社区再次发生农牧民冲突，据报造成3人死亡、多人受伤，房屋和商铺被烧毁。暴力事件从周六下午持续至周日早晨，居民称冲突起因是牛群啃食花生田。警方、军方、地方治安队和民防团已部署以恢复秩序，但联邦首都区警察发言人尚未回应置评请求。

location.raw_text: Paikon-Kore community in Gwagwalada Area Council of the Federal Capital Territory (FCT)

key_facts.fact: 农牧民冲突据报造成3人死亡、多人受伤，房屋和商铺被烧毁
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: a renewed farmers-herders clash reportedly killed three people, injured several others and left houses and shops burnt

key_facts.fact: 暴力事件从周六下午持续至周日早晨
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The violence began on Saturday afternoon and continued until Sunday morning

key_facts.fact: 居民称冲突因牛群啃食花生田引发
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: residents saying it erupted after cattle grazing on a groundnut farm triggered a confrontation

key_facts.fact: 警方、军方、地方治安队和民防团已部署至该社区
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: deployment includes personnel of the Nigeria Police Force, the military, local vigilantes and the Nigeria Security and Civil Defence Corps (NSCDC)

key_facts.fact: 联邦首都区警察发言人截至发稿未回应置评请求
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: she had yet to respond as of the time of filing this report

uncertainties: 伤亡数字为据报，尚未获官方确认
冲突起因系居民说法，尚未证实
警方尚未回应置评请求
目前仅单一来源报道，缺乏交叉验证
